data_fields.name: usableInventorySlots
data_fields.donor_constant: status.inventory_slots (per character, not read in full)

best_idea: Keep a second, reversible loadout: exchanging a parked item displaces whatever it covers, and the displaced items become the parked set, so one action swaps a whole kit.
decision_why: Take the loadout exchange as one server-side action with a plan-first check and keep the bitmask slot model; do not copy the donor order, which removes the parked item before its equip can fail and ignores the results.
acceptance: A server test gives a hero a worn two-hand weapon and a parked bow: exchanging the bow puts it on and parks the weapon; if the parked item fails the class check, the exchange is refused and both lists are unchanged.
